title: Seven demonstrators arrested at Volkel Air Base runway

tea.why: Demonstrators held an unannounced protest on the runway of a military air base.
tea.changed: Nov 26: Royal Netherlands Marechaussee arrested seven demonstrators on the Volkel Air Base runway.

summary: On the morning of November 26, 2026, seven demonstrators were arrested by the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee at Volkel Air Base in North Brabant. The activists staged an unannounced protest by sitting on the military base's runway. Authorities intervened and took the seven individuals into custody around 8:00 a.m. Following the arrests, a search of the airfield was conducted to ensure no other participants remained on the grounds, though no additional protesters were discovered. Officials stated that further investigation into the action is underway.
response: According to the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee, officers intervened at around 8:00 a.m., arrested seven individuals on the runway, and subsequently searched the premises to verify no other participants were present.

updates.text: Royal Netherlands Marechaussee arrested seven people on the Volkel Air Base runway during an unannounced demonstration.
